rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides architecture blueprints and validation tools for full-stack development with Python/FastAPI backends and React/TypeScript frontends. Exposes documentation on layered architecture principles, design patterns like Context+Hook and Service Registry, and SOLID principles as MCP resources. Includes tools for querying patterns, checking layer violations, validating file placement, and reviewing component architecture.
